    "R1 — Execute the required shared workspace package typechecks and fail on an empty selection. docs/architecture/checks.json:164-174 runs pnpm --dir .work/academy -r --filter ./packages/* exec tsc --noEmit, but both check-20261017T022400Z-eae0d4/logs/shared-5.log and the clean-checkout check's shared-5.log say 'No projects matched the filters'. Both run records nevertheless mark shared/5 passed. The runner's exit-zero rule cannot establish that this required target ran; the root typecheck does not include every package's tests/configuration. Use an unambiguous package selection/working directory with a no-match failure and verify the intended package inventory. Acceptance: the actual locked main and clean-checkout runs execute the selected package typechecks, including presentation; an empty/misspelled selection fails, and a deliberate type error in a selected package-only file makes this command fail.",
    "R2 — Finish binding the Academy web consumer's actual scratch inputs (attempt-01 R5). fingerprint.rs:172-207 and 293-345 bind .inputs/academy and only .work/academy/packages/presentation plus its installed desktop copy. Editing these after shared-prepare is invisible to every current fingerprint and verify_consumed_shared. An in-memory virtual edit of src/components/shell/app-shell.tsx left the dependency fingerprint unchanged and the file was never consulted. Acceptance: bind or verify the actual web consumer source/configuration before and after its consuming checks, with narrow documented exclusions for genuine generated outputs; edits to that shell or its test/build configuration invalidate the run/review, while both clean consumers still pass.",
    "R3 — Apply path confinement at the destructive staging entry point. shared.rs:236-255 still joins caller paths and uses lexical starts_with before clear_scratch; cli.rs:359-365 calls prepare directly. The new confined helper is used for lifecycle execution, not prepare. Thus --scratch .work/../apps or a scratch ancestor symlink outside .work can reach destructive cleanup outside the allowed tree once the input lock verifies. The helper-only tests do not cover this production path, and the prepare test at shell_controller.rs:1265-1273 permits an inputs.lock error before reaching confinement. Acceptance: prepare itself validates both roots and resolved paths before any deletion/copy; end-to-end tests with a valid locked input reject parent-component, absolute and symlink escapes and prove sentinel files outside scratch remain untouched.",
    "R4 — Revalidate the complete prepared bundle and its actual identity (remaining attempt-01 R2). native.rs records bundle_sha256, but current_executable_sha256 and complete.rs:250-259 recheck only the Mach-O file. evidence.rs trusts the record's identifier and does not bind app.bundle to the prepared bundle. An edited Info.plist/resource or mismatched bundle path can therefore retain an accepted executable hash while bypassing the recorded bundle/identity contract. The supplied bundle currently matches; this is a gate defect, not a claim it was tampered with. Acceptance: the gate and reference validator bind the prepared bundle path/hash, read its current CFBundleIdentifier, and reject changed/deleted non-executable bundle bytes, a different identifier or a mismatched acceptance bundle while accepting the intact prepared fixture.",
    "R5 — Make cumulative phase gates require current integrated native evidence. complete.rs:222-245 requires only check/test runs and returns no native expectation for every phase; review.rs:303-304 emits native_acceptance=null for phases, and gate.rs:235-237 consequently skips native validation. A phase can therefore complete with historical chunk receipts and passing check/test/verdict records but no native acceptance against its integrated tree, contrary to review-protocol.md and the phase prompt. Acceptance: define and bind the phase's required integrated native evidence to its current inputs/artifact and validate it, or explicitly fail closed until that support exists. A consistent all-nine phase fixture with missing/stale native evidence must fail through validate-receipt/complete; an appropriately complete current phase fixture must pass.",
    "R6 — Complete independent bootstrap schema equivalence (remaining attempt-01 R6). tools/reference-validator/validate_receipt.py:243-290 validates the verdict schema but not the request/receipt schemas or their strict shapes; similar strictness is absent for other controller records. I evaluated its validate function entirely in memory with a self-consistent passing control, resealed packet/verdict hashes and real bound C01 evidence. The control was accepted, but changing receipt.schema, adding an unknown receipt field, or changing packet.schema was also accepted. Rust gate::evaluate rejects those cases. Acceptance: independently validate the gate-relevant record schemas/required fields/unknown-field rules, add resealed semantic cases for these differences, and demonstrate both validators agree on the actual corrected receipt and the expanded adversarial matrix before C01 completion.",
    "R7 — Close all failed observations and avoid silent eviction (remaining attempt-01 R7). client.ts:328-345 retires on invoke rejection or a wrong response kind, but parseShellSnapshot can throw outside that cleanup path. An in-memory execution of the production facade with an invalid initial snapshot produced ContractViolation, zero callback closes and only a shell request, with no closeShell request; no stop function is returned. Separately, Host::register (lib.rs:136-146) aborts the oldest observation at the cap without a resync notification. Tauri's Channel end only unregisters its callback and does not call onmessage, so that observer silently stops receiving state/menu updates. Acceptance: invalid initial snapshot/observer initialization failures release both sides; at-cap admission either refuses the new observation while preserving existing ones or explicitly notifies retirement/resync without an unbounded resubscription loop. Test cleanup counts and observable continuity through the production facade/host, not only the registry size."
  ],

    "The required shared package typecheck has no execution evidence: shared/5 selected zero projects in both the main and isolated clean-checkout checks. Fresh source-bound evidence must show the corrected target actually executing; exit status zero from the current command is insufficient."

    "transport.rs:423-435 returns as soon as any matching reply exists, while gate.rs now correctly requires a task_complete final output.
